title: Language year in China
summary: A year of immersive Chinese: from zero to the level needed for a bachelor's or master's.
overview: A language year is the most flexible entry into Chinese education. You study on a university campus, build HSK and learn whether the country, city and study format suit you.

Programs exist at universities and private language centres. University programs give student status, housing and campus access; private centres can be cheaper but offer a weaker environment. We choose based on your next goal: bachelor's, master's or work.
fitFor: No HSK, or a level below the requirement
You need an academic year before a bachelor's
You want to test China before a longer program
You're planning a master's and want to improve the language
outcomes: HSK 3–5 depending on your start and intensity
Readiness to apply for the next level

timeline.text: We choose the city, budget and goal, then shortlist language schools and university programs.
We prepare the passport, certificate or degree, translations and supporting documents, then apply.
Offer, deposit, JW202 and an X1/X2 visa.
We help with housing, insurance, a SIM card and your first days on campus.

faq.question: Can I learn Chinese from zero?
faq.answer: Yes. Most language programs are designed for beginners and place students in groups after a test. A high school education is usually enough for the visa and enrolment.

faq.question: Does a language year give me the right to enter a Chinese university?
faq.answer: Not by itself. The year helps you reach the required HSK and prepare, but admission still requires a certificate or degree, documents and the specific university's requirements.
